title: bench(amd): package matched MI300X vLLM and SGLang run

host_prerequisites: amd-smi static enumerates AMD Instinct MI300X
container_prerequisites: in-container rocminfo exits 0 and enumerates gfx942
rejection_triggers: failed ROCm tools or ROCm version < 6.3
non-gfx942 target or non-MI300X device name
server exit before readiness or readiness timeout
missing exact model revision in server logs
CPU fallback, CUDA, NVIDIA, or missing GPU markers in logs

geometry.prompt: Explain in one sentence why matched benchmark geometry matters.

engines.name: vllm
engines.launch_command: docker run --name mi300x-vllm --rm --network host --device=/dev/kfd --device=/dev/dri --group-add video --ipc=host -e HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' <IMAGE_ID> Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --revision 7ae557604adf67be50417f59c2c2f167def9a775 --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18000 --tensor-parallel-size 1 --dtype float16 --max-model-len 2048

engines.name: sglang
engines.launch_command: docker run --name mi300x-sglang --rm --network host --device=/dev/kfd --device=/dev/dri --group-add video --ipc=host -e HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' --entrypoint python3 <IMAGE_ID> -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --revision 7ae557604adf67be50417f59c2c2f167def9a775 --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18000 --tp-size 1 --dtype float16 --context-length 2048

teardown.process_cleanup: terminate telemetry background subshell, wait PID exit
teardown.container_cleanup: docker stop mi300x-${ENGINE} with graceful timeout, then docker rm -f
teardown.guarantee: Zero orphan server processes, zero dangling containers, zero uncollected telemetry sessions
